# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/push_mirrors/{name}

Deletes a push mirror from a repository by its remote name

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-239`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **400** — Mirror feature disabled
- **403** — User is not repo admin
- **404** — Push mirror not found or error deleting
